args.title: Allow empty final line in imported CSV statements
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Modify parseStatement to handle a trailing empty line gracefully instead of treating it as a malformed row error. This prevents failing imports when statement files end with a blank line.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This issue is caused by the parseStatement function in src/ingest/parser.ts, which currently throws a 'Malformed row' error for rows that do not match the header length, including trailing empty lines. The fix is to adjust parseStatement to ignore or handle empty trailing lines so they don't cause errors during import.
